question: In a certain language, MOLE is written as ELOM. How will DRIVE be written in the same code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ea82bd5c97415b6a0bb4a31c9208d4af49dfee9c43ef8ee84e3fd4a2b56e847.png] 

**LOGIC: The word is rearranged according to reverse order (right to left)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87274bae6b014bc45f54a665d8df408267ea2e4c2b51a6cea60c3211ee65cc3e.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3f5e30fe34cee1df133897ada3149755ac53d91ac8cb5fdefdff4ddb53e692f.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"EVIRD".**
